subject: Encryption evidence: HSM seal log sample & rotation verification
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearsky.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearsky.com
Date: 2027-04-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: sample HSM seal logs + rotation proof for SIG

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake and internal risk review at Clearsky Financial, we need a small, redacted sample of HSM seal/log exports and a concise rotation verification artifact for the keys used for customers in our tenancy. Our auditor asked for: 

- One week of sealed HSM audit events (sample of ~100 rows) showing seal/unseal and admin operations, with timestamps and event types.
- A short attestation describing rotation policy, last rotation dates for tenant KEKs, and the process for emergency rotation/fallback.
- Any policy or runbook references (links OK).

Can you confirm what we can expect and whether you need an approved NDA/DPA for transferring logs to our S3 bucket? Ideally we would get the sample and attestation by EOD Wed (2027-04-28) — is that feasible?

Appreciate the quick help,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Security & Compliance Lead
Clearsky Financial

Attachment: SIG_encryption_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet of questionnaire rows)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearsky.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample HSM seal logs + rotation proof for SIG

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts you described; proposed plan below.

Plan (high level):
- Deliverables: 1) CSV sample of HSM seal/unseal/admin events (~100 rows) with sanitized host and account IDs; 2) PDF attestation summarizing key rotation cadence and last rotation dates for tenant KEKs; 3) Links to relevant runbook sections and CAIQ responses.
- Redaction: we will remove any PII and redact internal hostnames. We will not include private key material.
- Transfer: we prefer sending the sample to a pre-provisioned S3 path (we can publish a pre-signed object or push to s3://redwood-exchange/clearsky/). We will require a DPA or data transfer addendum before sharing logs.
- Timeline: initial sample + attestation by Tue 2027-04-27 EOD PST if DPA signed; otherwise we can provide masked screenshots for early review by Wed 2027-04-28.

Irene/Marissa — can you take point on extraction, redaction, and the attestation PDF? I can follow up with the Clearsky contact for the transfer details and DocuSign link.

Markus
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s) planned: redwood_rotation_attestation.pdf, hsm_seal_log_sample.csv
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearsky.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample HSM seal logs + rotation proof for SIG

Markus / Marissa — taking this on. Notes and extraction checklist below.

Extraction checklist:
- Source: HSM audit exporter (hsm-audit-prod, retention 180d). Query window: 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-07 as a representative week.
- Fields to include: event_time, event_type, operator_id (redact to opaque id), tenant_id (redact to tenant-XX), object_id, action, result, correlation_id.
- Redaction: replace hostnames with host-XXX, operator emails with op-####. No cryptographic key material or wrapped keys will be exported.
- Sampling: prefer contiguous block of ~100 rows capturing at least one rotation event and admin seal/unseal sequences.
- Validation: verify hashes of exported CSV and sign the attestation PDF with security@redwood.ai PGP key.

Delivery and approvals:
- We will prepare the CSV and the attestation PDF and place them in s3://redwood-exchange/clearsky/ (we will create a folder with TTL = 7 days). Please confirm the exact bucket name and whether we should upload as encrypted objects (recommended).
- For policy artifacts that reference secrets handling, we will include links to internal runbook pages (read-only).
- I am attaching a small redaction_template.txt we will use; please confirm clearance for that format.

Next steps:
1) Markus: confirm DPA status and send DocuSign envelope link.
2) Elaine: confirm S3 target and whether Clearsky needs server-side-encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) set by Redwood.
3) Marissa: I will hand off the extraction query and scrub script.

Irene Choi
Head of Security Engineering (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redaction_template.txt
